ios.desc:
FitSpire is your personal 5-minute workout companion designed for busy people who want real fitness results without long gym sessions.

Whether you want to lose belly fat, build strength, improve stamina, or stay active daily, FitSpire delivers quick, effective, and scientifically structured workouts you can do anywhere.

ONLY 5 MINUTES A DAY

FitSpire creates short, powerful workout routines that fit perfectly into your schedule. No excuses. No long commitments.

TARGET SPECIFIC BODY AREAS

Choose workouts for:
• Full body fitness
• Belly fat reduction
• Abs & core strength
• Arms & upper body
• Legs & lower body
• Flexibility & endurance

WORKOUT ANYWHERE – NO EQUIPMENT

All exercises are designed for home, office, or travel. No gym or equipment needed.

TRACK YOUR FITNESS JOURNEY

Stay motivated with:
• Workout streak tracking
• Performance analytics
• Progress insights
• Daily fitness summaries

PERFECT FOR BUSY LIFESTYLES

FitSpire is ideal for:
• Professionals with tight schedules
• Students and remote workers
• Beginners starting their fitness journey
• Anyone wanting quick daily workouts

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

FitSpire offers auto-renewable subscription plans:

• Weekly Plan – $3.99 per week (7 days)
• Monthly Plan – $5.99 per month
• Yearly Plan – $9.99 per year

A 14-day free trial is available for eligible users.

After the free trial ends, payment will be charged to your Apple ID account unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial period. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the selected plan’s price.

You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Fitspire – a simple 5-minute workout app for busy people (iOS)

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I just launched Fitspire, a small iOS app built around one idea: workouts shouldn’t require 45–60 minutes to be effective.

I’m a builder, and like many people working long hours, I found it hard to stay consistent with traditional fitness routines. Most apps felt either too intense, too time-consuming, or overloaded with features.

So I built Fitspire around:

1. Structured 5-minute workouts
2. Minimal, distraction-free UI
3. Simple progress tracking (streaks, reports, history)
4. No subscriptions at launch (100% free for now)

The goal isn’t to replace full gym training — it’s to reduce the friction of starting.

Tech stack:

1. Built with React Native
2. Backend with Firebase
3. iOS release via App Store

I’m mainly looking for feedback on:

Does 5-minute positioning make sense?
What would make this actually sticky?
Where do fitness apps usually fail in retention?

Would appreciate any honest feedback — especially critical ones.

Thanks.
